PREFIX zaguan: PREFIX text: PREFIX xsd:
SELECT DISTINCT ?doc WHERE { ?doc text:query "animación OR 'visión por computador'" . ?doc zaguan:language "spa" . ?doc zaguan:date ?date . FILTER (?date >= "2005"^^xsd:gYear && (?type = zaguan:TFG || ?type = zaguan:TFM)) } LIMIT 100

PREFIX zaguan: PREFIX text: PREFIX xsd:
SELECT DISTINCT ?doc WHERE { ?doc text:query "veterinaria" . ?doc text:query "gato OR perro" . ?doc zaguan:date ?date . FILTER (?date >= "2012"^^xsd:gYear && ?date <= "2018"^^xsd:gYear) } LIMIT 100

PREFIX zaguan: PREFIX text: PREFIX xsd:
SELECT DISTINCT ?doc WHERE { ?doc text:query "arte" . ?doc text:query "aragonés" . ?doc zaguan:date ?date . FILTER (?date <= "1899"^^xsd:gYear) } LIMIT 100

PREFIX zaguan: PREFIX text:
SELECT ?doc WHERE { ?doc text:query "algoritmos de búsqueda AND (medicina OR proteinas OR síntomas OR pacientes)" . } LIMIT 100
